title: qboot
description: Tool for computing q-ball ODFs using bootstrap samples

forcedir_flag.description: Use the actual directory name given - i.e. don't add + to make a new directory
forcedir_flag.title: Force directory flag

q_file.description: File provided with multi-shell data. Indicates the number of directions for each shell
q_file.title: Multi-shell data file

model_type.description: Which model to use. 1=Tuch's ODFs, 2=CSA ODFs (default), 3=multi-shell CSA ODFs
model_type.title: Model type

lmax_order.description: Maximum spherical harmonic order employed (must be even, default=4)
lmax_order.title: Lmax order

npeaks.description: Maximum number of ODF peaks to be detected (default 2)
npeaks.title: Number of peaks

threshold.description: Minimum threshold for a local maxima to be considered an ODF peak. Expressed as a fraction of the maximum ODF value (default 0.4)
threshold.title: Threshold value

delta_param.description: Signal attenuation regularization parameter for models=2,3 (default is 0.01)
delta_param.title: Signal attenuation parameter

alpha_param.description: Laplacian sharpening parameter for model=1 (default is 0, should be smaller than 1)
alpha_param.title: Laplacian sharpening parameter

gfa_flag.description: Compute a generalised FA, using the mean ODF in each voxel
gfa_flag.title: Generalized FA flag

savecoeff_flag.description: Save the ODF coefficients instead of the peaks. WARNING: These can be huge files, please use a few bootstrap samples and a low lmax!
savecoeff_flag.title: Save coefficients flag

savemeancoeff_flag.description: Save the mean ODF coefficients across all samples
savemeancoeff_flag.title: Save mean coefficients flag
